answer: A new account starts with zero standing and earns it only by presenting a chain of time-stamped proofs of attendance at distinct, verifiable events, each proof bound to one identity. The ferrous of forging a believable history is high because every proof is checked against an independent event record, and a proof reused across hundreds of accounts lights up at once. Proofs also expire, so the hollow of staying credible never ends: an account that goes quiet loses standing, and the basalt of old proofs cannot carry a new attack, forcing Sybils to keep paying for real participation.
